title: Oven Roasted Argentinian Zucchini Skillet
description: A sour and bouncy Argentinian dish featuring zucchini, perfect for a brunch mood, made with halal-friendly ingredients in a claypot vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the infused olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
In a large claypot, arrange a layer of sliced zucchini.
Brush the zucchini with the olive oil mixture and sprinkle with chopped red onion and red bell pepper.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of zucchini on top.
Cover the claypot with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the zucchini is tender and lightly browned.
Remove the claypot from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
